description: Model profiles shared by all three agents. 'default' names the profile used when no --profile (or --local / --openai) flag picks one. Precedence: --model / --base-url, then the environment variables named by model_env / base_url_env, then the values here. The key comes from the variable named by api_key_env; api_key is only a fallback for servers that need no real key.
